$comment: Optional add-on to consumer-settings.snippet.json: also enables the cloudflare-mcp plugin, which depends on Cloudflare's own official plugin (cloudflare@cloudflare) rather than declaring MCP servers itself — see plugins/cloudflare-mcp/README.md. That dependency only resolves if the 'cloudflare' marketplace is also known, which is why it's listed under extraKnownMarketplaces below alongside claude-code-studio. Merge both keys into what consumer-settings.snippet.json already gave you — do not include this $comment. OAuth for the Cloudflare servers triggers on first tool use in each session/account.
